title: pleurogramme seminuda
intro: Pleurogramme seminuda, commonly known as the 'Semi-Undressed Pleurogramme', is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogramme seminuda include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
